name: Patch File
description: Apply a unified diff patch for multi-hunk or insert-only edits. Prefer str_replace for simple unique substitutions.

function.name: patch
function.description: Apply a unified diff (@@ hunks) for multi-site or insert-only edits. Always read_file immediately before building the patch (line numbers shift after each apply). Prefer str_replace for simple unique substitutions. Supports create-new-file with @@ -0,0 +1,N @@.

path.description: Relative path under the sandbox cwd.

patch.description:
Unified diff body with @@ hunk headers. Example:
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 context line
-old line
+new line
 context line
Insertion-only: @@ -2,0 +2,1 @@\n+new line. Create file: @@ -0,0 +1,N @@ with only + lines.
